requirements.one: Age not less than 25 and not more than 60 years,
requirements.two: Able to present a residence ID or passport
requirements.four: የThe adoptive family must provide proof from a government agency or organization where they live that their monthly or annual income is sufficient to support the child in their current living situation. Without prejudice to the above, a copy of the house plan, a copy of a renewed business license, a car license, a bank deposit certificate, etc. may be accepted as proof of income.
requirements.five: They can provide evidence from the relevant authority that they are free from any incurable, chronic, and communicable disease (including Hepatitis B and HIV/AIDS), as well as mental illness;
requirements.six: They can provide evidence from the relevant authority proving that they are free from any criminal activity
requirements.seven: Applicants must be able to provide proof of the spouse's agreement to adopt a child/application signed by both parties, stating the date, month, and year
requirements.eight: Proof of marriage, singleness, divorce, or death of spouse
requirements.nine: Marriage certificate (for those who are single, divorced, or deceased) from the relevant government agency;
requirements.ten: Applicants must provide evidence of their psychological and social well-being from relevant bodies, such as a religious institution, a religious organization, or the district office.
requirements.eleven: The adoptive family must provide two passport-size (3×4) photographs.
